name: Mataram
scopeLimits: The local ATR/BPN office confirms parcel-boundary inspection and land-right processing in Mataram. Official city SIMTARU serves spatial-planning and zoning functions, not cadastral parcels. BHUMI documentation describes the national map platform, but public WFS GetCapabilities and DescribeFeatureType requests to its `umum:Persil` proxy returned HTTP 403; no geometry was queried or retained.
pointBasis: UN WUP 2025 population-weighted settlement centroid; this is not a municipal boundary or a parcel-coverage claim.
registryBasis: Kantor Pertanahan Kota Mataram (ATR/BPN) publishes city-specific field-inspection work involving plot boundaries and land-title processing, establishing a local registry/procedure. The article concerns a different kelurahan and does not prove WUP-point parcel coverage.
technicalBlocker: BHUMI WFS metadata proxy returned HTTP 403 before the layer schema could be validated; SIMTARU is a planning/zoning portal rather than a parcel source.
remainingUncertainty: Whether the public BHUMI parcel layer covers the WUP point and offers an anonymous geometry query with a safe identifier allowlist.
nextStep: If the official service exposes an approved public schema route, verify its layer and bounded WUP-point coverage using only safe IDs and geometry.
